topic: licensing risk when delivering AI-generated work to clients
blind_spots: The freelancer evidence is anecdotal and comes from a single Reddit discussion; prevalence across the market is unknown.
The technical API excerpts do not establish a licensing pain point, despite appearing in an article about licensing traps.
Ownership and copyrightability of AI-generated outputs are not directly addressed.
The evidence does not specify recommended indemnity, disclosure, attribution, audit-trail, or model-training consent clauses.
The evidence does not identify specific AI vendor license terms, commercial-use restrictions, or differences between free and paid plans.
There is no evidence of an actual infringement claim, takedown, client dispute, denied insurance claim, or financial loss arising from an AI-generated deliverable.
No evidence establishes who should bear licensing risk among freelancer, agency, client, and AI vendor.
